name: 47540-penaltylongdecode-30ba3b-2gpu
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 (two GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:2).
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine, mp executor.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, warmup declared at the first 50% by completion, bounded at 64 requests -- exactly one full resident wave -- with a 5400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, `request_format: plain`, prompt exactly 256 tokens and output exactly 8192 (ignore_eos), sampled at temperature 1.0 with frequency_penalty 0.2 and repetition_penalty 1.1.
purpose: A long-form story writing service producing 8192-token chapters from short prompts for 64 concurrent authors on two GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line at commit b790c84cde050c39f37a0a1f967e877d4c2fb4c9
# (`git describe --tags` = v0.23.1rc0-751-gb790c84cde05). The interpreter that realizes it, and
# the hardware, are named by configs/env.yaml and are not portable. Nothing here is tuned.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B

tensor-parallel-size: 2
distributed-executor-backend: mp

dtype: bfloat16

# Equal to the declared stream count, so the whole batch sits in one decode step.
max-num-seqs: 64
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-model-len: 8704
# Sized so all 64 streams stay resident to their last token; a run that preempts is not this setup.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# HAZARD: this engine turns prefix caching ON by default. Forced off so every request prefills.
enable-prefix-caching: false

# A resolved default (not a literal one) written down so a build cannot resolve it differently.
async-scheduling: true

# HAZARD: the checkpoint's generation_config.json carries temperature 0.6, top_k 20 and top_p 0.95.
# `vllm` keeps those from being layered under the sampling declared in scenario.json.
generation-config: vllm
